description: Fetch an agent's bootstrap to start processing: identity (persona/values/models), granted brains, tool permissions, work queue (pending todos + upcoming events + due reminders), PLAINTEXT skill/memory summaries, and team — the user's OTHER agents (id, name, description, persona summary, brains/domains), so this agent can recognize work that belongs to a teammate and delegate_task to them instead of guessing or handling it out of scope. Token-budgeted (agent_profile.bootstrap_token_budget). Stamps last_bootstrap_at. kompakt:true (for scheduled/takt runs): values and rules unchanged, skills as name + one line (full steps via recall_skill), memory capped to the 20 most important, tool permissions only as exceptions, team without persona — a full bootstrap can exceed 50k chars.

agent_id.description: Agent id from list_agents, or the agent's exact name (resolved within this tenant).

kompakt.description: Small answer for scheduled runs (see description).

name: get_agent_bootstrap
